plans.how: Architects' plan with a 25/50/100 ft scale bar (100 ft = 270 px, 11.25 cm/px) and a north arrow. With that scale, the rotation (-1.9 deg) and position come from fitting the building footprint on the sheet to the building outline (median 2.7 m, 90% within 8.4 m; the outline is OSM's roof line). Check: UCLA GIS restroom 1276 (floor 1) lands in the restroom block at the east end of the main building. Four synthetic control points carry that transform.
